info.title: Drivich API
info.description: Self-hosted file storage. Authentication uses a session cookie; every non-GET request must carry the header `X-Drivich-CSRF: 1`. Errors have the shape `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`.

put.summary: Pause kinds and set concurrency limits

get.summary: Version, database, disk, counts and jobs

post.summary: Reset a user's password (closes their sessions)
Create an account (when sign-ups are enabled)

get.summary: Current user, storage usage and Immich address

patch.summary: Update name, Immich address or interface language

put.summary: Set the profile picture (raw image body, 5 MB max)

requestBody.description: The image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP)

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: drive (default), shared, recent, starred or trash

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: folder, image, video, audio, pdf, text, document or archive

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Recent view only: drive or shared

post.summary: Apply an action to several items

delete.summary: Delete an item that is in the trash, permanently

get.summary: Inline content for the viewer (unsafe types are served as text)
Download the file (HTTP Range and ETag supported)

post.summary: Create a public read-only link (token returned once)
Record that the file was opened (feeds Recent)

get.summary: Who has access, and active links
The item a public link points to
An item inside a public link
Inline content through a public link
Up to 8 name matches while typing

post.summary: Permanently delete everything in the trash

patch.summary: Send a chunk (header Upload-Offset, raw body); the last chunk returns the file

get.summary: Find users by name or email prefix (sharing dialog)

action.description: trash, restore, star, unstar, move or delete

JobControls.description: Admin-controlled behaviour of the queue (stored in `settings`).

limits.description: Maximum simultaneous jobs per kind, across all workers (absent = no limit).

paused.description: Kinds that are not started while paused (running jobs finish).

token.description: The raw token, returned only once.

immich_url.description: Effective Immich address: personal, else the server default.

Node.description: A file or folder as returned by the API.

role.description: Effective role of the caller: `owner`, `editor`, `commenter` or `viewer`.

parent_id.description: `null` moves the item to the root of My Drive.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag; `null` follows the browser.

immich_url.description: Personal link to the user's Immich instance (overrides the server default).

UserBrief.description: Minimal public view of a user, used by the sharing dialog.

session.name: drivich_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by /auth/login or /auth/setup. Every non-GET request must also send the header `X-Drivich-CSRF: 1`.
